question: Who signs off a £900 customer refund on 15 November 2026?
answer: Noah Chen signs off the £900 refund on 15 November 2026. Refunds above £750 require Payments Lead approval [S4], and Noah holds that role [S2]. His delegation to Mira Shah ended on 31 October 2026, so he retains approval on the requested date [S5].
